comments.body: PSA: we merged a spec [change](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11908/changes) to EIP-8037.

## Glamsterdam upgrade mascot

Mascot Wrestler (@eviljordan) has published the results on Eth Magicians: https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/mascot-needed-for-glamsterdam-upgrade/26008

🦩 Flamingo was the top candidate as voted by the community and is the final mascot *(unless vetoed by a rough consensus of client teams).*

From : https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8066#2-roles-and-responsibilities

> **Veto Powers:**
> * The Mascot Wrestler MAY veto any candidate mascot not meeting the mascot requirements above.
> * A rough consensus of client teams MAY veto the selected mascot, triggering fallback to the next-highest-ranked candidate mascot.

|Emoji|Name|Votes|
| --- | --- | --- |
|🦩|Flamingo|45|
|🐻‍❄️|Polar Bear|39|
|🐹|Hamster|21|
|🦫|Beaver|18|
|🐙|Arctic Octopus|11|
|🐜|Ant|9|
|🐩|Poodle|5|
|🐝|Bee|3|

> A rough consensus of client teams MAY veto the selected mascot

🐻‍❄️
